Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Senior Alliance Solutions Engineer Opportunity

Okta believes in Partners and, together with our technology, will help take Identity mainstream and consolidate our position as a Leader in the market.  Partner Solutions Engineers are dedicated to growing Okta business through the Channel, working closely with Regional Alliance Managers, Sales Representatives, Marketing and Partner Enablement.  As a Partner Solutions Engineer at Okta, you will have an opportunity to be a well-respected technical expert, building strong, long standing relationships with key Partners and Global System Integrators, supporting both global and India markets.  You will become your partners’ trusted advisor for anything Identity and Access Management related and will help them understand how Okta can best fit in their Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy, integrate with their current offerings, help evangelize partner solutions within the Okta field teams and lead our partners in building Okta practices that deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

*This role requires in-person onboarding and travel to our San Francisco, CA HQ office during the first week of employment. 

What you’ll be doing 

  • Build and manage technical relationships with assigned Partners and team with the assigned Okta Partner Account Team
  • Drive incremental revenue through increased Okta solution sales with the support of Strategic Partners and their GTM strategies.
  • Develop domain expertise and thought leadership regarding the Partners’ current areas of focus as well as in new areas for expansion
  • Gather, track, and translate partner feedback to help steer the Okta product roadmap
  • Deliver technical training sessions for Partners (leading workshops, demoing Okta features, explaining best practices and competitive differentiators)
  • Field technical questions, inquiries and Request for Information from the Partners through in-person, virtual and office hours and provide support for building Partner COEs
  • Establish and maintain technical expertise on current and developing Okta products and technology
  • Provide oversight, guidance, and assistance during the Partners sales process (including RFP responses) to ensure mutual success
  • Up to 25% travel in support of Partner, Okta and industry events

How you’ll be measured

  • Direct and influenced revenue growth
  • Partner developed and driven GTM Solution Offering driven into the market / their customer base
  • Partner enablement and resource certification growth

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 5+ years pre-sales engineering experience.
  • Experience with implementing Okta, Auth0 or both
  • An understanding of IAM / IDaaS competitive landscape
  • Experience supporting or enabling partner ecosystems or alliances in cloud security, identity, or cybersecurity
  • Strong presentation and communication skills at a technical level
  • A passion to serve the partner as our customer and ensure their success within their customer bases. 
  • Experience with at least one standard network security protocol. (OAuth, OAuth2, SAML, LDAP, OIDC)
  • Knowledge in one or more of the following areas: web (Javascript, HTML, frontend frameworks) development, mobile (iOS, Android) development, backend (Java, C#, Node.js, Python, PHP, Ruby) development, IP-based real-time communications
  • Hands-on experience in cloud computing environments (AWS, GCP, Azure) 
  • Confident dispensing knowledge to a highly skilled and experienced audience.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, MIS or a comparable field is preferred.

At Okta, we are building the future of secure, enterprise-grade cloud automation and system connectivity. We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our global Automation Engineering team to design, scale, and govern our enterprise integration substrate using AWS cloud services and modern iPaaS platforms.

This is a individual contributor role for a hands-on system engineer who executes moderately complex tasks, builds platform components and collaborates under senior guidance.

What You'll do :

  • Contribute technical design and execution for automation initiatives within the team, creating paved paths that enable builders across Okta to connect enterprise systems seamlessly.
  • Design, build, and deploy high-throughput event-driven integration flows, API gateways, and async orchestration workflows using AWS architectures and iPaaS platforms.
  • Build reusable frameworks, developer SDKs, self-service primitives, and integration templates to streamline automation delivery.
  • Develop and maintain AWS cloud services and modern iPaaS tooling, driving scalable architecture, reliability, and builder enablement.
  • Partner with operations, security, and platform teams to strengthen monitoring, observability, structured audit logging, and automated governance.
  • Actively participate in code reviews, team agile ceremonies, and technical discussions
  • Collaborate with security, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure self-service automations are secure, resilient, zero-trust aligned, and enterprise-ready.
  • Maintain and enhance platform primitives and integration components to meet evolving enterprise and builder requirements.

What we are looking for : 

  • 2+ years of software engineering experience in Java and Python, focused on platform engineering, backend systems, distributed architectures, and enterprise integrations.
  • 1+ years of hands-on experience with modern front-end frameworks (React, Next.js, TypeScript) to build intuitive developer portals, operator dashboards, and self-service interfaces.
  • Solid working knowledge of AWS and event-driven architectures alongside enterprise iPaaS platforms (Zapier, n8n, etc).
  • Strong knowledge of software engineering best practices: IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation), CI/CD release automation, API contract design (REST/GraphQL), and unit/integration testing standards.
  • Experience in platform reliability, central logging, error recovery, operational observability, and self-service governance frameworks.
  • Demonstrated success in building internal platform tools, self-service capabilities, or paved paths that empower and accelerate engineering teams across an enterprise.
  • Hands-on experience with AI development and integrations, embedding LLM capabilities, agentic primitives, or intelligent features into cloud automations.
  • Familiarity with AI-driven SDLC practices, leveraging AI-assisted coding tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate software delivery while maintaining safety and quality guardrails.

Why Join Us:

At Okta, you’ll join a global Automation Engineering team building secure, enterprise-grade cloud automation and system connectivity. You’ll shape the platform foundations, integration patterns, and self-service capabilities that help teams automate complex workflows at scale. If you’re passionate about building platforms that are scalable, resilient, and secure, this is your opportunity to make an impact across Okta.

MongoDB is the modern database platform and consistently voted the #1 most wanted database, preferred by developers. MongoDB continues to attract the most demanding and innovative companies and development teams in enterprise software.

To support this growth, we are expanding our Industry Solutions Team (IST), a flexible, globally distributed organization that helps customers and partners modernize applications and data platforms with MongoDB.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer in our Industry ISV Practice, you will work directly with independent software vendors (ISVs) and their engineering organizations to build MongoDB capabilities into their products. You will work in the partner’s codebase, languages, engineering practices, and release process to deliver production-ready integrations, migrations, and product capabilities. The solutions you help build should leave the partner with maintainable code and knowledge, while creating reusable patterns that can accelerate future partner engagements.

This is a hands-on application engineering role. You will spend time understanding existing products built on relational databases, designing practical MongoDB approaches, writing production code, and working alongside partner engineers through implementation and rollout. The role requires regular travel and time on-site with ISV partners during key phases of the engagement.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

What you’ll do at MongoDB

In this role, you will

  • Embed with ISV engineering teams, adapting to their codebase, practices, release cadence, and constraints while understanding their product architecture, industry context, data model, and deployment environment
  • Design and build MongoDB-backed product capabilities, including integrations, data models, indexes, queries, persistence layers, migration tooling, and support for MongoDB alongside relational database editions
  • Design and implement coexistence and migration solutions, including synchronization, change data capture (CDC), dual writes, consistency, application refactoring, validation, and controlled cutover
  • Design and validate production-ready solutions for performance, scalability, resilience, observability, security, and operational readiness across MongoDB Atlas, Enterprise Advanced, Kubernetes-based private clouds, and self-managed or restricted on-premises environments
  • Enable partner engineers through collaborative development, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing, while working with internal technical teams to resolve design questions and establish support boundaries
  • Capture reusable implementation patterns, tooling, product gaps, and lessons learned to accelerate future partner engagements

As an ideal candidate, you will have

  • 5+ years of hands-on backend engineering experience building and operating production applications
  • Strong application-side expertise with MongoDB, including data modeling, access patterns, aggregation, indexing, transactions, change streams, and a clear understanding of query and transaction semantics
  • Application-level fluency with at least one major relational database, including relational data modeling, access patterns, database drivers or ORMs, indexing, transactions, query planning, and transaction-isolation assumptions
  • Experience integrating a new database into a large production codebase and migrating production workloads, including persistence abstractions, data synchronization, dual-write or CDC patterns, application refactoring, validation, and incremental rollout
  • Strong coding ability in at least two languages such as Java, C#/.NET, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, or Go, plus experience with APIs, distributed systems, containers, and cloud or self-managed deployment environments
  • Experience with SaaS and product engineering, including multi-tenancy, tenant isolation, versioned schemas, and backward compatibility, together with the ability to work effectively in unfamiliar codebases and explain technical trade-offs clearly
  • Willingness to spend significant time on-site with ISV partners and travel within the region

As an ideal candidate, you may also have

  • Experience working for or with an ISV, or in a forward-deployed, embedded, resident-engineer, or partner-engineering role
  • Familiarity with event-driven and microservices architectures and technologies such as Kafka, as well as performance engineering, observability, resilience, or production-readiness reviews
  • Exposure to security and compliance requirements for ISVs serving regulated industries
  • Experience creating reusable tooling, reference implementations, integration components, or technical documentation, along with MongoDB certification, Atlas experience, or familiarity with MongoDB’s broader product portfolio

What you will learn

  • Gain practical experience modernizing applications and delivering MongoDB solutions for partner products across different industries, including coexistence and migration scenarios in cloud-native environments, while developing reusable patterns and your technical and communication skills
  • Broaden your perspective on how data-intensive products evolve and develop the judgment to translate diverse product and operational requirements into practical MongoDB solutions

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

MongoDB Professional Services (PS) works with customers of all shapes and sizes, in all verticals, from tier-1 banks to small web startups, on a variety of exciting use cases. This role solves technically sophisticated problems, gains incredible cross-stack experience, works with top-notch people in the business, networks with industry leaders, and sees new places - all in a day’s work!

MongoDB PS exists to support the development of our customers’ vision, accelerate customers’ time to value, and drive a multitude of customer adoption scenarios – from building new solutions to modernizing legacy applications or migrating to cloud. Our consulting solutions ensure that organizations get the best out of MongoDB.

Work as a software developer in a small Agile team delivering solutions onsite for customers focussed on migrating our customers’ legacy relational-based Java applications to a more modern cloud-based architecture running on MongoDB, leveraging the latest GenAI tools and approaches to accelerate this process. During each project, successful candidates will be required to innovate on potential new GenAI-based solutions for specific challenges in addition to applying existing playbooks and tooling for migration.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.

As an Application Delivery Consultant, you will work closely with customers to deliver tailored solutions for modernizing their legacy SQL-based systems and applications. Your role will involve collaborating with bite-size Agile teams, applying best practices, and contributing to system redesigns that leverage MongoDB. This is an excellent opportunity for candidates with strong technical fundamentals and a passion for learning, as the role provides extensive training and exposure to modern technologies like MongoDB, GenAI, and cloud-native architectures

Position Expectations:

  • Collaborate with project teams to deliver solutions for modernizing legacy SQL-based applications and migrating them to MongoDB
  • Apply your knowledge of Java (or similar programming languages) and relational databases to support customer projects
  • Follow and contribute to best practice playbooks for migrations and modern application development
  • Continuously learn and adopt new technologies, especially MongoDB, GenAI tools, and cloud architectures, as projects demand

Okta is seeking a Staff  Analyst – People Technology to join our Business Solutions Team. In this critical role, you will partner closely with the People Technology leadership and play a key role in our Workday transformation efforts. As part of a cross-functional team, you will collaborate with stakeholders across People, Payroll, IT, Finance, and international offices to optimize and scale our HR systems and processes.

This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about solving complex business challenges, driving innovation through automation, and delivering a best-in-class user experience.

Job Duties and Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end architecture and technical design of Workday Extend applications, integrations, and supporting technology solutions.
  • Define scalable, secure, resilient, and maintainable application architecture, integration architecture, data flows, API strategies, and technical standards.
  • Architect and lead the development of complex Workday Extend applications using TypeScript/JavaScript, Workday APIs, and Extend frameworks.
  • Architect enterprise Workday integrations using Workday Studio, EIB, Core Connectors, RaaS, REST APIs, SOAP Web Services, and Workday Web Services.
  • Evaluate business requirements and determine the appropriate solution across Workday configuration, Extend, integrations, APIs, AI, cloud services, and third-party platforms.
  • Establish architectural patterns and reusable frameworks for Workday Extend applications and integrations to support scalability, extensibility, security, and long-term maintainability.
  • Provide technical leadership for the complete application lifecycle, including architecture, design, development, testing, deployment, release management, and production support.
  • Develop solutions that leverage AI and Generative AI to enable intelligent automation, enhanced user experiences, decision support, and innovative business capabilities within the Workday ecosystem.
  • Assess and utilize AWS cloud services where required to support application components, APIs, integrations, data processing, AI capabilities, and enterprise workloads.
  • Define and govern API, integration, security, authentication, authorization, error-handling, monitoring, logging, and performance strategies.
  • Partner with enterprise architects, business stakeholders, functional leads, security teams, cloud teams, and engineering teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise technology standards and business objectives.
  • Lead technical discovery, architecture workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology evaluations, and solution estimations for complex business initiatives.
  • Review and approve technical designs, application architecture, integration patterns, and development approaches to ensure adherence to architectural standards.
  • Identify technical risks, dependencies, scalability concerns, and opportunities for modernization, and define appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance when required while leading and mentoring senior developers and engineering teams.
  • Establish development and engineering best practices, including code quality, version control, CI/CD, testing, observability, documentation, and deployment standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement of the Workday technical landscape by evaluating new capabilities across Workday Extend, Workday Integration, Orchestrate, AI/GenAI, AWS, APIs, and emerging technologies.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 8 to 10 years of overall IT/software development experience.
  • 4+ years of hands-on Workday Extend experience.
  • Workday certification in Extend
  • Strong hands-on experience with Workday Integration Frameworks.
  • Strong experience with Workday Studio.
  • Experience with EIB, Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, and Workday Web Services.
  • Strong knowledge of Workday REST/SOAP APIs.
  • Experience with RaaS, Workday Reports, Calculated Fields, and Business Processes.
  • Strong understanding of Workday HCM architecture and Workday data model.
  • Experience designing and developing enterprise-grade integrations.
  • Working knowledge of AWS cloud services.
  • Exposure to AI/ML and Generative AI technologies.
  • Strong understanding of API-based and event-driven integration architectures.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience integrating LLM/GenAI APIs into enterprise applications.
  • Knowledge of AWS Bedrock or equivalent enterprise AI services.
  • Experience with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, EventBridge, or similar AWS services.
  • Understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, and AI agents.
  • Experience building AI-powered automation or employee-facing applications.
  • Exposure to CI/CD, DevOps, Git, automated testing, and cloud deployment practices.
